$comment: Every string the player reads. Ids are stable and describe what the text is for; {name} marks a value filled in by the game. To translate, copy this file and keep the ids.
stat.strength.name: Strength
stat.strength.description: Raw physical power: melee weapons add its modifier to hit and to damage, and heavy armour needs it. Points on gear also lengthen your swing.
stat.dexterity.name: Dexterity
stat.dexterity.description: Agility and reflexes: ranged and finesse weapons add its modifier to hit and to damage, and it raises your Armor Class (fully in light armour, up to +2 in medium).
stat.constitution.name: Constitution
stat.constitution.description: Toughness and stamina: a Barbarian with no armour adds it to Armor Class. Points on gear let you sprint for longer.
stat.intelligence.name: Intelligence
stat.intelligence.description: Reasoning and arcane skill: your Fire Bolt adds its modifier to hit.
stat.wisdom.name: Wisdom
stat.wisdom.description: Awareness and insight. It has no effect yet.
stat.charisma.name: Charisma
stat.charisma.description: Force of personality. Each point on gear makes enemies drop 5% more coins.
slot.head: Head
inventory.title: INVENTORY
sheet.ac.name: Armor Class
sheet.ac.description: How hard you are to hit: a blow lands when the attacker's d20 roll plus their bonus reaches your AC. With no armour it is 10 + your DEX modifier (a Barbarian adds CON too). Armour sets its own base instead (light adds all of DEX, medium at most +2, heavy none), a shield adds +2 and a Warrior's Defense style +1 in armour.
sheet.hp.name: Hit Points
sheet.hp.description: How much harm you can take before you fall. In the tabletop game your class's hit die decides it (a d12 a level for a Barbarian, a d10 for a Warrior, plus CON); here every hero starts with 100.
sheet.proficiency.name: Proficiency Bonus
sheet.proficiency.description: Added to attacks with weapons you are trained in, to your spells, and to the two saving throws your class is trained in. It grows with level: +2 at levels 1-4, +3 at 5-8, and so on.
sheet.initiative.name: Initiative
sheet.initiative.description: Who acts first when a fight breaks out: d20 + your DEX modifier.
sheet.speed.name: Speed
sheet.speed.description: How far you move in a round, in feet. Heavy armour you lack the STR for slows you by 10 ft.
sheet.speed.slowed: {armor} is too heavy for you: -10 ft
sheet.passive.name: Passive Perception
sheet.passive.description: What you notice without searching: 10 + your WIS modifier. Hidden foes and traps at or under it are spotted.
sheet.hit_dice.name: Hit Dice
sheet.hit_dice.description: One die a level, by class: rolled for more hit points as you level up, and spent to heal on a short rest.
sheet.spell.name: Spellcasting
sheet.spell.description: Your spell bolt hits on d20 + proficiency + your casting ability. A spell a foe resists makes them beat your spell save DC: 8 + proficiency + that ability.
sheet.spell.untrained: Not a caster: Intelligence stands in
sheet.saves.name: Saving Throws
sheet.saves.description: Rolled to resist poison, spells and traps: d20 + the ability's modifier, plus your proficiency bonus for the two your class is trained in (in gold).
sheet.dmg.name: Weapon Damage
sheet.dmg.description: What a hit with your weapon deals: its dice plus a modifier. Melee weapons add STR, ranged ones DEX, and finesse weapons (dagger, shortsword, scimitar...) the better of the two. A magic weapon adds its bonus to hit and to damage; a versatile one hits harder with the other hand free.
combat_log.title: COMBAT LOG
combat_log.toggle_aria: Show or hide the combat log
proficiency.title: {class} proficiencies
proficiency.armor_description: Your class decides which armour you are trained in. Wearing armour you are not trained in gives disadvantage on every attack roll: two d20s are rolled and the lower one counts.
proficiency.weapons_description: Simple weapons (clubs, daggers, spears, short bows) and martial ones (swords, axes, polearms, longbows). A weapon you are trained in adds your proficiency bonus (+2 at level 1) to hit; others don't.
hero.kaelen.name: Kaelen
hero.kaelen.blurb: A veteran of a hundred sieges in plate and steel: the wall the party stands behind.
hero.malkorath.name: Malkorath
hero.malkorath.blurb: A shadow with a blade and a few arcane tricks, striking where it hurts most.
hero.malthus.name: Malthus
hero.malthus.blurb: A holy knight sworn to burn the undead from the land, armoured in faith and steel.
hero.vesper.name: Vesper
hero.vesper.blurb: A scholar of the arcane who learned fire from old books and older ruins.
hero.xanthia.name: Xanthia
hero.xanthia.blurb: Born with light in her blood, she wields it raw and bright against the dark.
hero.barbarian.name: Barbarian
hero.barbarian.blurb: A fierce warrior of primal rage, toughest of all heroes. Fights best in light gear, or none.
hero.warrior.name: Hooded Knight
hero.warrior.blurb: A crowned knight in a tattered cloak, at home in any armour and with any weapon.
feature.unarmored_defense.name: Unarmored Defense
feature.unarmored_defense.description: With no armour on, AC is 10 + DEX + CON (a shield still adds).
feature.fighting_style_defense.name: Fighting Style: Defense
feature.sneak_attack.name: Sneak Attack
feature.sneak_attack.description: +1d6 damage with finesse or ranged weapons.
intro.part1:
Beneath the jagged peaks of the Carpathians lies a land suffocated by an endless nightmare.

Every full moon, as the church bells toll midnight, a suffocating dread settles over the valleys. From the ancient, brooding castle atop the cliffside, tides of risen dead pour out into the surrounding realms, leaving butchered villages and silent graveyards in their wake.

No army can breach the fortress walls. High ladders rot before they touch the stone, and siege engines shatter against a towering, ethereal barrier of dark magic that seals the castle grounds from the outside world.

There is only one way in.
intro.part2:
A league away, a gaping chasm cuts into the frozen earth—the mouth of a labyrinthine dungeon stretching deep beneath the mountains. It is through these sunken corridors that the undead emerge, and it is the only physical passage into the fortress above.

The local magistrate, desperate and running out of time, has put out a final plea for aid. The last party of sellswords sent into the abyss never returned.

Now, the contract falls to you. Descend into the subterranean darkness, fight through the teeming horrors in the depths, reach the high spires of the castle, and destroy the dark necromancer before the next moon rises.
